newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE V RAPID VIENNA TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE V RAPID VIENNA TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup Champions' League group C match between Fenerbahce of Turkey and Rapid Vienna of Austria:

Fenerbahce - 1-Rustu Recber, 2-Ilker Yagcioglu, 3-Uche Okechukwu, 4-Jes Hogh, 5-Kemalettin Senturk, 8-Tuncay Akgun, 9-Elvir Bolic, 10-Augustine "Jay Jay" Okocha, 11-Emil Kostadinov, 14-Saffet Akbas, 15-Erol Bulut

Rapid Vienna - 1-Michael Konsel, 4-Trifon Ivanov, 5-Peter Schottel, 6-Peter Stoger, 9-Marek Penksa, 10-Dietmar Kuhbauer, 11-Christian Prosenik, 15-Andrzej Lesiak, 16-Krzysztof Ratajczyk, 17-Rene Wagner, 20-Andreas Heraf
